versions.changelog:
- Added complete multi-language documentation (Chinese, English, Japanese) for all instructions and features.
- Enhanced skill description with concise, multi-language summaries for better accessibility.
- Unified and streamlined feature, usage, and output documentation in all supported languages.
- Clarified command-line instructions and standardized interface explanations across languages.
- No code changes; documentation update only.

- Initial release of the brain-teaser-game interactive skill.
- Supports brain teasers, riddles, and quiz questions in Chinese, English, and Japanese.
- Automatically detects user language and ensures no repeated questions.
- Features include smart answer checking, hint system, and game history tracking.
- Offers a command-line interface for answering, hints, viewing answers, next questions, and session management.
- Optional support for generating new questions via external AI API.
